meta.title: 센티넬 X
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (센티넬 X, an AI security platform (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 센티넬 X, an AI security platform (fictional)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Neon on black: #030407 for the night, cyan #2EF2FF for everything that is normal (the network, the radar, the shield), magenta #FF2E9A only for attacks and the X, white cores in every tube, grey-blue #8FA6B2 for small print.
rationale.type: Orbit, a squared sci-fi Korean face, drawn as neon: a wide glow, a coloured outline and a white core; small print plain.
rationale.motion: Neon behaviour: tubes switch on with the stutter of a real sign and hum; the network draws itself edge by edge and carries packets; the radar turns once a bar; attacks are invisible until the sweep crosses them, then burn and are stopped with a shield pulse on the node.
rationale.sound: Dark synth at 128 BPM in D minor (8 bars in 15 s, 16 in 30 s), saw pad, saw-pluck arps, rolling saw bass and stabs on a full kit; digital SFX: a lock-on beep for each attack seen, a hit for each one stopped.
rationale.visuals: All code: additive three-pass neon strokes and lettering, a fixed network of fourteen nodes and twenty edges, a radar wedge, attacks with deterministic reveal times, a hexagon dome, a faint grid.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the cards carry it.
